The note also does not describe plausible-value (PV) estimation or scaling procedures at the student level; instead, it points readers to the corresponding Education at a Glance 2025 tables and to the OECD Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes. For any re-analysis using the underlying microdata (e.g., PIAAC for adult literacy or other ILSA sources referenced by the indicators), analysts should consult the Education at a Glance 2025 technical documentation to apply the correct survey weights and PV combining rules for each underlying study.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD country note for Croatia summarizes key education-system characteristics using published indicators from Education at a Glance 2025, with a thematic emphasis on tertiary education. It reports descriptive comparisons such as intergenerational educational attainment gaps, trends in upper-secondary attainment, and adult literacy proficiency levels (from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills/PIAAC), alongside education participation, progression, and resource-allocation indicators. The note also provides system-level figures on instruction time, subject allocation, student-to-academic-staff ratios by institutional research focus, and government expenditure per student across education levels. No student-level machine learning models are estimated, and no PV or missing-data handling strategy is described in the note itself; instead, it points to the Education at a Glance 2025 tables and the OECD Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes for the underlying indicator methodology. Therefore, the results should be interpreted as descriptive benchmarks rather than causal or predictive estimates.

The note also does not specify PV estimation or missing-data procedures because it does not conduct original estimation; it references the underlying OECD technical documentation where those details are provided.
